title: Granular.Build
lede: Granular is a visual workspace where a lead agent breaks a goal into parallel jobs for specialist agents, with models, files, terminals and project memory kept in one place.

points: A boss agent takes the goal and coordinates specialist agents running in parallel.
Apps, designs and videos show up as live previews while the agents work on them.
Users bring their own models, with built-in terminals and plugins available when a task needs them.
Each project keeps its own memory and files together; the launch comment says you can point it at an existing folder.
The founder says the site, gallery images and promo video were all made inside Granular itself.

sections.text: People without a programming background who want several agents on one project, and builders tired of juggling terminals, IDEs and single-agent chat apps.
